findings_p1.title: Orphaned spec — dev-workflow-platform.md has 0% implementation coverage
findings_p1.detail: Spec defines 69 FRs for a feature-request/bug-report/dev-cycle management platform. Source/ implements a completely different system: the Self-Judging Workflow Engine. No FR-001–FR-069 requirement is traced in source code.
findings_p1.failure_scenario: Agent reading Specifications/ as domain truth attempts to build feature-request system; generates hallucinated implementations conflicting with actual workflow-engine codebase
findings_p1.recommendation: Add '## Status: Future / Not Yet Started' header OR archive the spec; clarify that Source/ implements Specifications/workflow-engine.md, not dev-workflow-platform.md

findings_p1.title: vitest@2.0.5 — Prototype Pollution RCE via tinypool
findings_p1.detail: CVE via tinypool <=2.1.1: worker.options allows arbitrary property injection; RCE in test execution environment. vitest UI --ui flag exposes arbitrary file read/execution vector.
findings_p1.failure_scenario: Malicious test file or vitest UI --ui flag exploitation allows arbitrary code execution via tinypool worker option prototype pollution
findings_p1.recommendation: npm update vitest@5.1.0+ (major version bump required)
findings_p1.escalation: TheGuardians [ESCALATE] — if vitest runs user-supplied test code in CI/CD pipeline

findings_p1.title: handlebars@4.7.9 — Critical JS Injection via AST type confusion
findings_p1.detail: Multiple critical CVEs: AST type confusion allows JavaScript code execution via @partial-block, dynamic partials, decorators. Ranges: >=4.0.0 <=4.7.9.
findings_p1.failure_scenario: If user-supplied Handlebars templates are compiled, AST type confusion allows arbitrary JavaScript execution on the server
findings_p1.recommendation: npm update (triggers handlebars@4.7.10+ via transitive resolution); identify which build tool depends on handlebars
findings_p1.escalation: TheGuardians [ESCALATE] — injection risk if user templates compiled

findings_p1.title: proxy-addr@2.0.7 — IPv4-mapped IPv6 trust bypass (IP spoofing)
findings_p1.detail: CVE-2024-50332: IPv4-mapped IPv6 addresses (::ffff:x.x.x.x) bypass app.set('trust proxy') subnet checks. Affects any Express server trusting proxy headers.
findings_p1.failure_scenario: Attacker sends ::ffff:192.0.2.1 to bypass trust proxy subnet checks; enables IP-based access control bypass in k8s/load-balancer deployments

findings_p1.title: uuid@9.0.0 — Buffer overflow (missing bounds check) + 5 major versions outdated
findings_p1.detail: CVE-2024-24391: Missing buffer bounds check in v3/v5/v6 when buf parameter provided. Can write past buffer. Also 5 major versions behind (9.0.0 vs 14.0.3).
findings_p1.failure_scenario: If uuid is called with an attacker-controlled buf parameter, missing bounds check allows buffer overwrite causing memory corruption
findings_p1.escalation: TheGuardians [ESCALATE] — requires code review to verify no untrusted buf parameter usage

findings_p2.title: Traceability enforcer silently skips dependency-linking plan
findings_p2.detail: Enforcer auto-picks the most recently modified requirements.md. Right now it only covers Plans/self-judging-workflow; silently skips Plans/dependency-linking (16 FRs). Will flip without warning when either plan is touched.
findings_p2.recommendation: Add --all-plans flag or CI step that runs enforcer per active plan

findings_p2.title: dependency-linking delta shows 3 items as Missing that are already Done
findings_p2.detail: FR-dependency-api-types, FR-dependency-seed, FR-dependency-frontend-tests all marked Missing but all exist in Source/. Stale delta will mislead next agent reading the plan.
findings_p2.recommendation: Update delta table: mark all three Done; note FR-dependency-seed is N/A for in-memory store variant

findings_p2.title: vite@5.4.0 — 7 path traversal CVEs (dev server arbitrary file read)
findings_p2.detail: Multiple CVEs: fs.existsSync() bypass (Windows), server.fs.allow bypass, alternate path bypass. All in vite <=6.4.3.
findings_p2.recommendation: npm update vite@8.3.8+ (major bump; breaking changes expected)
findings_p2.escalation: TheGuardians [SEE] if vite dev server exposed beyond localhost

findings_p2.title: body-parser@1.20.8 — DoS via trailing bytes in compressed requests
findings_p2.detail: GHSA-27r3-jxmh-p828: Compressed request with trailing data causes indefinite processing, CPU exhaustion. CVSS 7.5.

findings_p2.title: brace-expansion@1.1.20 — 7 DoS CVEs (exponential expansion, stack exhaustion)
findings_p2.detail: Multiple DoS vectors: exponential-time expansion, unbounded recursion, stack exhaustion. Triggers on malformed brace patterns.

findings_p2.title: browserslist@4.28.6 — Unbounded memory growth + prototype pollution
findings_p2.detail: GHSA-c83g-rgw3-j3cx: No cache eviction on distinct queries → OOM. GHSA-73wf-gq98-2v4g: Prototype pollution via untrusted browserslist-stats.json.

findings_p2.title: react-router-dom@6.26.0 — Open redirect (3 CVEs, protocol-relative bypass)
findings_p2.detail: GHSA-2j2x-hqr9-3h42: Same-origin check bypass via // protocol-relative URL. GHSA-wrjc-x8rr-h8h6: backslash bypass. GHSA-337j-9hxr-rhxg: Arbitrary constructor injection in SSR hydration.
findings_p2.escalation: TheGuardians [ESCALATE] if user input can influence navigation targets
